ideas.pitch: An automated Anti-Money Laundering risk detection and transaction graph analysis platform for decentralized finance protocols.
ideas.problem_statement: Detecting complex money laundering patterns across cross-chain decentralized finance transactions without creating massive false positives for legitimate users.
ideas.title: ChainGuard AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Imitates the multi-faceted risk intelligence and graph analysis architecture seen in previous hackathon winners like Bito, directly addressing the FinTech domain with hard backend engineering.

ideas.pitch: A privacy-preserving local AI assistant that securely sanitizes internal codebases and sensitive enterprise documents before querying cloud LLMs.
ideas.problem_statement: Preventing accidental data leaks of proprietary corporate assets and PII when engineering teams leverage external AI coding and text-generation tools.
ideas.title: SecureMind AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a high-demand enterprise cybersecurity use case with practical local LLM routing, following the winning blueprint of secure infrastructure developer tools.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized patient record auditing platform utilizing zero-knowledge proofs to verify clinical trial eligibility without exposing raw personal medical histories.
ideas.problem_statement: Protecting patient medical privacy during cross-institutional clinical research data sharing and recruitment verification pipelines.
ideas.title: MediGraph Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages zero-knowledge privacy mechanisms to solve a stringent HealthTech compliance requirement, inspired by winning architectures that prioritize cryptographic data protection.

ideas.pitch: An NLP-powered multilingual grievance classification and automated dispatch routing dashboard for municipal public works departments.
ideas.problem_statement: Sorting, prioritizing, and acting on thousands of unstructured citizen complaints and civic infrastructure failure reports submitted across multiple channels.
ideas.title: CivicPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles a concrete CivicTech operations bottleneck using proven text classification models and an intuitive triage interface reminiscent of award-winning data science solutions.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent simulation framework for backtesting and executing automated arbitrage and liquidity strategies on decentralized perpetual exchanges.
ideas.problem_statement: Designing reliable automated trading strategies that adapt dynamically to volatile market conditions without relying on static, inflexible rule sets.
ideas.title: AgenticTrade
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on complex agentic workflows and automated financial execution frameworks, mirroring the technical ambition and grand prize success of prior trading bot platforms.
